scope: Gemini image models (Nano Banana family) in the Gemini Developer API. Facts from official pages only; no vendor text is reproduced. Each model entry carries its own aspect ratios, thinking levels, reference limits and grounding, because the official tables differ per model.
aspect_ratios_basis: The union of the aspect ratios of all image models. Each model's own list is in models[].aspect_ratios: the 14 values only for gemini-nano-banana-2.1 and gemini-3.1-flash-image (guide, per-model tables, 2026-10-13).

image_sizes.512_basis: Guide (2026-10-13): 'Gemini 3.1 Flash Image adds the smaller 512px (0.5K) resolution (not supported on Gemini Nano Banana 2.1)'; its per-model table lists 512px for 3.1 Flash only. The Interactions API reference (read again 2026-10-13) lists image_size values 512, 1K, 2K and 4K. The generate-content reference (read again 2026-10-13) lists the enum IMAGE_SIZE_FIVE_TWELVE for 512px. The guide also writes the label as '512px (05.K)' once. No live call was made. The only model with 512 px is deprecated (gemini-3.1-flash-image), so the studio does not offer 512 px.

inline_request_limit_basis: Image understanding page (read again 2026-10-13): 'Inline image data limits your total request size (text prompts, system instructions, and inline bytes) to 20MB.' The studio counts each reference as base64 characters plus the prompt bytes, the conservative reading.
thinking_levels_basis: Enum in the API reference. The guide's per-model table (2026-10-13) lists the subset each model accepts; its examples send lowercase values such as 'high' in generation_config.thinking_level.
reference_total_basis: Guide (2026-10-13): 'Mix up to 14 reference images'. The per-type limits of each model add up to this total (10 + 4, 6 + 5 + 3, 14).

prompt_structure.source: cloud_prompting_guide_dated_2026_03_05; the same formulas are in the Cloud blog
prompt_structure.section: Image generation: text-to-image without references, and generation with references

grounding_search.scope: shared across Gemini 3 and newer models (pricing page)
grounding_search.image_search_basis: Guide (2026-10-13): Grounding with Google Image Search 'is only available for the Gemini Nano Banana 2.1 and Gemini 3.1 Flash Image models'.

c2pa.status: stated for one model page and the Cloud blog; the guide is silent
c2pa.basis: SynthID: the guide (updated 2026-10-09) says all generated images include a SynthID watermark. C2PA: the Nano Banana 2 Lite model page (updated 2026-09-03) says 'SynthID watermarking (Always On) + C2PA', and the Cloud blog (2026-03-05) says all generated images include C2PA Content Credentials. The guide and the other model pages read on 2026-10-13 do not mention C2PA. The guide does not deny it, so this is a gap, not a contradiction.
c2pa.recommendation: Promise SynthID only. Do not promise C2PA for any model. If a user asks, say that the Lite model page and the Cloud blog state it, and that the file metadata is the check.

bare_family_name.basis: The guide describes gemini-nano-banana-2.1 as the primary high-efficiency workhorse (2026-10-13). A family name ('Nano Banana', 'Gemini Image') with no version names the family, not the 2025 model, which is 'Gemini 2.5 Flash Image'.

models.routing: Default for new projects. Primary high-efficiency model for image generation and conversational editing; Google Search grounding; text rendering and infographic layout; multi-turn consistency.

models.deprecation_basis: Release notes, 2026-10-06: 'The gemini-3.1-flash-image model is deprecated (no shutdown date announced). Migrate to gemini-nano-banana-2.1.' The deprecations table (2026-10-12) also gives no shutdown date and names gemini-nano-banana-2.1 as the replacement.
models.label_basis: Model page 'Versions' (updated 2026-10-09): 'Stable: gemini-3.1-flash-image'. This label does not reflect the 2026-10-06 deprecation; the release note sets the status. GA release on 2026-05-28 (release notes and deprecations table).
models.token_limits_basis: Model page (updated 2026-10-09): input token limit 131,072, output token limit 32,768.
models.routing: Deprecated (2026-10-06). Migrate new work to gemini-nano-banana-2.1. Still the only model in the guide with 512 px. The studio does not offer it for new briefs.

models.display_name: Nano Banana 2 Lite (Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image)
models.label_basis: Model page 'Versions' (updated 2026-09-03): 'Stable: gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image'. Release date 2026-06-30 (deprecations table and release notes). No deprecation announced.
models.token_limits_basis: Model page (updated 2026-09-03): input token limit 65,536, output token limit 4,096. The model page also says 'Supported image_size values: 1024px (1K). (Note: 2K and 4K are unsupported).'
models.routing: Fastest and cheapest. 1K only. Not optimized for many reference inputs or long sequential edits (guide, 2026-10-13).
models.aspect_ratios_basis: Guide 'Features' section: 'Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image adds 1:1, 3:2, 2:3, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9 aspect ratios.' The guide has no per-ratio pixel table for this model; 1:4, 4:1, 1:8 and 8:1 are not listed for it.
models.aspect_ratios_conflict: The Lite model page (updated 2026-09-03) says 'Supports a discrete set of 14 aspect ratios including standard formats', and lists the same ten as new. Read that way, Lite would also take 1:4, 4:1, 1:8 and 8:1. This catalog keeps the ten listed ratios, the stricter reading: the studio refuses a ratio before approval, so a wrong refusal costs a redirect, while a wrong acceptance costs a paid call the API may reject. Confirm before offering the four extreme ratios for Lite.

models.label_basis: Model page 'Versions' (updated 2026-09-03): 'Stable: gemini-3-pro-image'. GA release on 2026-05-28 (release notes and deprecations table); the '-preview' ID was the earlier model (2025-11-20).
models.routing: Premium choice for complex visual tasks and professional asset production: world knowledge, localization, brand consistency, creative control. Not in the guide's 'controlling thinking levels' table.
models.aspect_ratios_basis: Guide per-model table '3.1 Pro Image' (2026-10-13). 1:4, 4:1, 1:8 and 8:1 are not in it.

thinking.basis: Not listed for thinking-level control in the guide (2026-10-13). Thinking is on and cannot be disabled.

models.reference_limits_conflict: Resolved in favour of the table. The table lists 6 object, 5 character and 3 style references, which add up to the 14 total. The Limitations sentence says 'supports 5 images with high fidelity, and up to 14 images in total'. Its 5 matches the character count, not the 6 high-fidelity objects in the table, so the sentence and the table disagree on the object count. The per-type table is used.
models.input_token_basis: Model page (updated 2026-09-03): input token limit 65,536. The Cloud blog (2026-03-05) gives the same number.
models.output_token_basis: Model page (updated 2026-09-03): output token limit 32,768. The Cloud blog (2026-03-05) gives the same number for 3.1 Flash and Pro.

models.aliases_note: The bare name 'Nano Banana' is not an alias of this model. It names the family (see bare_family_name).
models.status_conflict: The deprecations table (read 2026-10-13) lists a shutdown date for it, and the pricing page warning (read 2026-10-13) says it 'is deprecated'. The release notes of 2026-09-18 say the 2.5 models 'are not deprecated' and that access is limited to users who used them before. The release notes have no deprecation entry for this model. The model page (updated 2026-09-03, before the deprecation pages) says Stable.
models.label_basis: Model page 'Versions' (updated 2026-09-03): 'Stable: gemini-2.5-flash-image'. This page is older than the deprecation pages, so the status above follows them.
models.routing: Legacy, with access limited. Say that it is deprecated and that its shutdown date is disputed. The table's replacement is Nano Banana 2 Lite. Do not promise that it still works.
models.shutdown_conflict: Open. The deprecations table gives 2027-03-15 and its note says the dates are the earliest possible shutdown dates. The pricing page warning gives 'October 2, 2026'. That date is earlier than the table's lower bound and has already passed, and the warning names Gemini 3.1 Flash Image as a migration target although the 2026-10-06 release note deprecated it. The catalog does not use the warning's date. No date is treated as confirmed, so shutdown is null. A live check would settle it; the owner declined live tests.
models.token_limits_basis: Model page (updated 2026-09-03): input token limit 65,536, output token limit 32,768.
models.replacement_conflict: The deprecations table names Nano Banana 2 Lite. The pricing warning names Gemini 3.1 Flash Image or Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite Image. The first of these is itself deprecated (release notes, 2026-10-06).

thinking.basis: Thinking levels are not documented in the pages read (2026-10-13).

models.reference_total_basis: Guide Limitations (2026-10-13): 'works best with up to 3 images as input'. Not a hard limit in the pages read.

outside_catalog.reason: Text reasoning model, not an image model. Release notes (2026-10-13): generally available. Its model page (updated 2026-10-13) lists image generation as 'Not supported', and its pricing lists text input, output, caching and grounding prices, with no image price. Not used for image routing; the validator and the studio do not match it.
